title: Case #2: The Phantom Rider
summary: A member is billed for rides she swears she never took. Count your way to the truth.

steps.title: Case #2
body: Mina Thorpe, a teacher and a Spokes member for six years, is furious. Her card **C-2190** has been charged for long rides **in the middle of the night**. She was asleep. Teodor thinks she's lying to dodge the bill.
Rosa disagrees. *"People lie. Aggregates don't. Group the trips and look for a pattern that doesn't belong to a teacher."*
Tables: `cards(card, holder, status)`, `trips(id, card, bike, station, day, hour, minutes, fare)`, `depot_access(id, employee, day, hour)`.

steps.title: Clue 1: who rides at night?
prompt: For trips with **hour between 0 and 4**, return each **card** with its number of night trips (**night_trips**) and their total fare (**night_fare**). Most night trips first.
Tables: `cards(card, holder, status)`, `trips(id, card, bike, station, day, hour, minutes, fare)` and `depot_access(id, employee, day, hour)`. `hour` is 0 to 23.
solution: SELECT card, COUNT(*) AS night_trips, SUM(fare) AS night_fare
setup: CREATE TABLE cards (card TEXT PRIMARY KEY, holder TEXT, status TEXT);
INSERT INTO cards VALUES ('C-1001','Ana Sousa','active'),('C-1002','Ben Okoro','active'),('C-2190','Mina Thorpe','active'),('C-3005','Raf Duarte','active'),('C-4410','Lotte Brand','paused');
CREATE TABLE trips (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, card TEXT, bike TEXT, station TEXT, day TEXT, hour INTEGER, minutes INTEGER, fare REAL);
CREATE TABLE depot_access (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, employee TEXT, day TEXT, hour INTEGER);
hints: WHERE for the night hours, GROUP BY card.
steps.explain: Two cards ride at night. Raf Duarte is a night-shift nurse with short trips home. C-2190 has five long night trips.

steps.title: Clue 2: two different riders
prompt: Look at card **C-2190** only. For each **station**, return **day_trips** (hour 5 or later), **night_trips** (hour 0 to 4), and **avg_minutes** (rounded to the nearest whole number).
Tables: `cards(card, holder, status)`, `trips(id, card, bike, station, day, hour, minutes, fare)` and `depot_access(id, employee, day, hour)`. `hour` is 0 to 23.
solution: SUM(CASE WHEN hour >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS day_trips,
SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 0 AND 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS night_trips,

hints: Conditional aggregation: `SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)`.
steps.explain: Two patterns on one card. By day: ten-minute hops around Lantern Square. By night: fifty-minute rides that all start at **Depot Yard**, the staff-only maintenance yard. Members can't even get in there.

steps.title: Clue 3: the phantom's nights
prompt: For the night trips from **Depot Yard**, return each **day**, the **bike** used, and the number of trips (**trips**), in date order.
Tables: `cards(card, holder, status)`, `trips(id, card, bike, station, day, hour, minutes, fare)` and `depot_access(id, employee, day, hour)`. `hour` is 0 to 23.
solution: SELECT day, bike, COUNT(*) AS trips
WHERE station = 'Depot Yard' AND hour BETWEEN 0 AND 4

steps.title: Name the culprit
prompt: Somebody badged into the depot **at night (hour 0 to 4)** on **every one** of the five phantom nights: `2026-06-09`, `2026-06-10`, `2026-06-11`, `2026-06-13` and `2026-06-14`.
